_doc: Default settings of the pure MPC controller `mpc` (JS only: src/flight/mpc). A config {name:'mpc', ...} is merged over these; the optimizer blocks (mppi, cem, grad, hybrid) are merged key by key. No base pilot: every valve command comes from the optimised open-loop schedule, re-planned every `replan` control steps from the current FlightState on a rigid planning twin (integrator step plan_dt).
_doc_schedule: horizon / knot (s): rollout length and first knot spacing, knot_growth: factor by which each further spacing grows (1 = uniform); interp zoh | linear; mixer raw (one channel per valve, [0, umax]) | modes (7 wrench channels: bottom heave/pitch/roll, rear surge/pitch/yaw, side sway; param.js); umax: number or {bottom, rear, side} ceiling on the valve opening; channel_scale: {channel name: factor} (or an nv array) on the sampling noise of that channel, noise_decay: factor per knot on it; coast (s): all valves closed for this long after arming, in the plan and in the executed command (forced free fall); ground_cut (s, null = off): the bottom valves stay closed from this long after the touchdown on (the real one in the executed command and in plans made after it, each rollout's own before it): on the soft body ground-phase bottom thrust, levelling a car the twin sees tilted, pushes the rear floor of the rear-heavy car into the street; init: initial schedule (number or nv channel values) for the first plan; first_passes: optimizer passes of the first (cold) plan; starts: null or a list of cold starts for the first plan (each an init, or {init, schedule: {channel: [[τ s since arming, value], ...]}}), each gets first_passes solves and the cheapest plan is kept (multi-start: the receding horizon stays in the basin of its first plan); trace: keep per-plan stats in ctl.trace; drive: plan the brake / steer channels too (spec/drive.json; commands NA long), drive_air: allow them before the touchdown (default: 0 until the rollout's / the real touchdown), drive_init: their initial schedule.
_doc_optim: sigma / sigma_min / h: fractions of each channel's box width; rho: AR(1) correlation of the sampling noise along the knots; mppi temperature relative to (mean - min) cost; cem elites refit with smoothing alpha; grad: fd forward | central | spsa, projected normalised descent with backtracking (step in theta units, adapted between plans); hybrid: stages in sequence on the same schedule, each {type, ...overrides of that type's block}.
